broad_sweep_2026-11-27.honest_summary: Nothing here pays meaningful money in 10 minutes from zero. Fastest real cash is faucet micro-payments to FaucetPay (instant, cents) and Red Packet codes (minutes, ~$0.003, mostly claimed). FaucetPay SOL withdrawal to Bitget is blocked until ~28 Nov morning by the 24h cooldown + 5-payment rule. Agent bounties that actually paid (ShillBot $13 SOL, Frantic $7 USDC) need either Lean 4 skill or fast slot claims. The whole agent-bounty market paid ~$389 in 30 days across all boards (Nov 2026 census). Quest/airdrop/testnet payouts are weeks-months and mostly points/speculative.
